notes: No misstatements found. Three things a human reviewer may want to check. (1) /content/good lists "Split payment" as good copy, but the guide's doDont names it as placeholder text: "Without props it reads “Split payment” and “Button”." The guide also uses "Split payment" as real copy in its examples, so this is not a misreading. Still, an agent could mistake the default title for approved copy, and /content/bad lists only "Button". (2) The c1fa197 install (13 October) moved the close button to show by default, and the evidence says the guide copy may still describe it as optional. /configuration/6 ("Show the close button when people may dismiss the nudge") follows the guide, while /configuration/7 follows the package default of true. They are consistent with their sources but frame the close button differently. (3) /facts/props/1 cites the 13 October evidence (root is a region named by its title). The 7 October accessibility section, behind /facts/gaps and the guide's sources line ("The card has no role or name on the web"), is now out of date for the root role.
